decisions.reason: As a recent line extension in the firm’s core door-hardware range with no visible sign of underperformance, it stays above a minimum aspiration level and is worth retaining while market acceptance becomes clearer.
This mitred handle family fits the firm’s design-led architectural positioning, and in the absence of evidence of a shortfall the prudent boundedly rational choice is to keep it on the market.

Because the multifunctional handle supports the firm’s system-solution and accessibility logic, management would keep it while learning whether its broader functionality translates into sustained demand.
A standard door lever handle is close to the firm’s established competence base, so unless results clearly fall below aspiration there is little reason to withdraw it after only one year.
Its dedicated product presentation and 2023 German Design Award indicate performance above aspiration and strong reputational value, making retention the clear choice.

The light patinated bronze finish is a low-risk extension of the existing portfolio that supports architectural choice and can be carried with available organisational slack until demand is better observed.
